expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.N===500 && Math.abs(S.B-0.2)<1e-9 && Math.abs(S.f-2)<1e-9 && Math.abs(S.A-0.002)<1e-12 && S.running===true && S.speed===1 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: N = 500, B = 0,20 T, f = 2,0 Hz, A = 20 cm², running, normal speed

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===2 && Number(R[0].min)===0.05 && Number(R[0].max)===0.3 && Number(R[0].step)===0.05 && Number(R[1].min)===1 && Number(R[1].max)===5 && Number(R[1].step)===0.5 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: two sliders: B 0,05–0,30 T in steps of 0,05, f 1,0–5,0 Hz in steps of 0,5
selects: turns 250/500/1000, animation speed slow/normal/fast

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); const c=k.findIndex(x=>x==='canvas'||/sim-canvas/.test(x)); return b[0]==='Pysäytä' && c>=0 && c<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button Pysäytä first; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words
